poses.caption: Lie on your back with one leg flat. Support the raised leg behind the thigh and gently straighten its knee. Keep your head and pelvis relaxed on the mat; hold 20–30 seconds and switch legs.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Premium original ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1406 HAMSTRING LYING STRETCH. ONE STATIC HOLD, exactly one full body person supine on thin gray mat, side three-quarter view head LEFT feet RIGHT. Back of skull shoulders pelvis relaxed resting on mat, head NEVER lifted. LEFT nonworking leg fully extended flat on mat to RIGHT with heel grounded. RIGHT working leg lifted upward about75degrees from floor, knee nearly straight slight softness, working foot above hips, ankle neutral. Both hands clasp gently behind raised RIGHT thigh BELOW buttock and ABOVE knee, fingers wrap sides of thigh, elbows bent not pulling neck. Keep pelvis grounded neutral back. Primary raised RIGHT hamstrings at BACK of thigh RED: distal exposed posterior thigh red muscle detail; upper covered hamstring only diffuse red educational tint on intact black shorts cloth, NO muscle contours/striations visible through shorts. All other anatomy grayscale. Fully opaque BLACK athletic tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK, BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH including raised leg with continuous hems seams broad real cloth folds no transparency/cutaways. Detailed fine grayscale EXPOSED limb muscle contours realistic fingers feet proportions. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins whole head both feet hands mat within square. Reference original project rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup chest red. Equal male/female quality. No text captions labels arrows extra panels.
